title: Paradox Dust
text: Advanced condensation turns spacetime knots into alternating black-and-white powder. Right-click consumes one dust and rolls one of five equally likely paradoxes.

Blink exactly 20 blocks along your view, without finding a safe destination; restore health and hunger; summon a random dream creature; summon a void anvil that waits three seconds overhead before falling; or receive one random earth, water, fire or air microcore.
The anvil uses ordinary falling-anvil damage and vanishes on landing, leaving no block or item. Stability fields can still prevent the blink.
